---
title: "SpatialResize"
---

## Overview

`SpatialResize` is the **DeepLearning-internal** pixel-center coordinate API
used by all channel encoders and decoders when mapping between
`source_image_size` / `target_image_size` and tensor `(H, W)`.

**Header:** `src/DeepLearning/spatial/SpatialResize.hpp`  
**Tests:** `tests/DeepLearning/spatial/SpatialResize.test.cpp`

This module is **not** linked outside `DeepLearning`. Mask raster resize for
the rest of the application remains in [`mask_utils`](../../DataObjects/Masks/utils/mask_utils.qmd),
which uses the same convention via `map_dest_to_source`.

## Convention

Integer pixel indices are **pixel centers** at `(i + 0.5)` in continuous space
(`align_corners=false`, PyTorch / OpenCV grid).

| Operation | Function | Formula (one axis) |
|-----------|----------|-------------------|
| Continuous image → tensor | `continuous_image_to_tensor` | `t = (x + 0.5) * T / I - 0.5` |
| Continuous tensor → image | `continuous_tensor_to_image` | `x = (t + 0.5) * I / T - 0.5` |
| Discrete mask encode | `discrete_image_to_tensor` | `lround(t_cont)`, clamped |
| Discrete mask decode | `discrete_dest_to_source` | same as `map_dest_to_source` |
| Rasterize float geometry | `discrete_tensor_nearest` | `lround(t_cont)`, clamped |

Discrete indexing uses **`std::lround`** (half away from zero), not truncation.

## Regression probe points

Canonical fixture: **640×480** image, **256×256** tensor, no crop.

| Image | Continuous tensor | Discrete tensor | Round-trip shift |
|-------|-------------------|-----------------|------------------|
| (297, 161) | (118.50, 85.63) | (119, 86) | (0, 0) |
| (301, 178) | (120.10, 94.70) | (120, 95) | (0, 0) |
| (228, 230) | (90.90, 122.43) | (91, 122) | (0, 0) |
| (209, 245) | (83.30, 130.43) | (83, 130) | (0, 0) |
| (281, 188) | (112.10, 100.03) | (112, 100) | (0, 0) |

Before this refactor, decode and encode used mismatched grids; see the handoff
doc for the prior behavior table.
